summary: Sibling of Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta; John's great-grand-uncle/aunt.
bio:
Listed among Mollie's siblings in the FS tree (Savino 1897-1964, Mariano Martin 1899-1941, Maria 1902, Antonio 1907-1998, Giuseppe 1912-1971, Rosa 1914, Charles J. 1916-1975). The family lived in Dunmore (Ward 5) 1910-30.

Rosa (FS: b. 1914, no sources) is not in the household in the January 1920 census, which lists every other child born before 1916 who was not yet married ([R4-S1]). She probably died in early childhood, before 1920. No death record was found.
sources: [R4-S1] 1920 US census, Dunmore borough Ward 5, ED 48, sheet 8B (10 Jan 1920), 133 Sand Street: Frank 'Genet' (51, head, owned with mortgage, immigrated 190-, alien, laborer R.R. shops), Angelina (46, imm. 1909, alien), Sam (21), Marion (20), Anthony (12, imm. 1909), Molly (9, b. PA), Joseph (8), and a son aged 4. Image attached to FamilySearch tree GLBZ-Z91 (index ark 1:1:MFTM-GCK).
